answer_1.quote: We conducted experiments on the WMT 14 English-German and English-French news translation task, and obtained +1.29 and +1.37 BLEU improvements respectively on top of the strong Transformer Base baseline, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach.

answer_2.quote: We used a beam size of 4 for decoding, and evaluated tokenized case-sensitive BLEU with the averaged model of the last 5 checkpoints for Transformer Base and 20 checkpoints for Transformer Big saved with an interval of 1, 500 training steps.
